name: Fire Tongs
description: Jim's fire tongs, from beside the stove. Long. For coals. And, today, a sash.

name: Grand Currency
//: Story Phase 14: the Grand Currency is its own counter (story variable grand_currency_tokens), never gold. It buys nothing anywhere.
description: GRAND STENCHMASTER GRAND TOKENS OF GRAND CURRENCY: {num:grand_currency_tokens} of them, in a crate in the galley (and everywhere else). Cheap plastic. NOT LEGAL TENDER, it says on every one. Squawks says: bad money.

variants.description: GRAND STENCHMASTER GRAND TOKENS OF GRAND CURRENCY: {num:grand_currency_tokens}. NOT LEGAL TENDER. Not redeemable at any branch, the only branch having concluded business. What they're for, according to Brogath: being wealthy.

name: Teller's Badge
description: CAPTAIN STINKBEARD. ACTING GRAND TELLER OF GRAND ATMOSPHERIC ASSETS. YOUR GAS IS OUR BUSINESS! Brass, nearly. The pin is bent. A souvenir of a bank that no longer exists.

name: Holiday Branch
description: A miniature Christmas ornament shaped like THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST. HOLIDAY BRANCH: NO TELLER REQUIRED! It cannot redeem currency, contains no money, cannot be entered and performs no banking.

variants.description: The HOLIDAY BRANCH (NO TELLER REQUIRED!), on loan to the Grand Stenchmaster, who has hung it from a point of his Grand Crown. He says it completes the regalia. It performs no banking.
